steps.text:
Subject: Sincere Apology for the Delay in Your Hardware Replacement  

Dear [Customer Name],

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to sincerely apologize for the delay in delivering the replacement hardware you requested. We understand how critical timely service is to your operations, and we regret any inconvenience this has caused.

The delay was due to an unexpected supply‑chain issue that impacted the availability of the specific component you need. Please be assured that our team has been working diligently to resolve the situation, and the replacement is now scheduled to ship on **[Expected Ship Date]**. You will receive a confirmation email with tracking details as soon as it is on its way.

We truly value your partnership with us, and we are committed to providing the high level of service you deserve. As a token of our appreciation for your patience, we would like to offer you a **[e.g., {{int:8:12}} % discount on your next purchase / complimentary service visit]**.

If you have any questions or need further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact me directly at **[Your Phone Number]** or reply to this email. I am here to help and ensure the remainder of the process proceeds smoothly.

Thank you for your understanding and continued trust in us.

Warm regards,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Title]  
[Your Company]  
[Phone Number]  
[Email Address]
